jobs.title: Junior Software Developer - System Integration Labs (North Shore)
jobs.description:
Our engineers are the technical visionaries behind our innovative solutions. Globally recognized for delivering cutting-edge systems, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate across functions, and lead advancements that shape our industry. Supported by a culture of flexibility, growth, and innovation, join us to create a lasting legacy in safety and simulation.  

**Description**

As a Software Developer, you will develop real-time simulation software used in military aircraft system integration laboratories. These engineering simulators reproduce aircraft systems and functions so that teams can test and validate software before it is installed on an aircraft. The emphasis is on aircraft controls and system behaviour rather than visual simulation.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop object-oriented software components, primarily in C++, to reproduce aircraft behaviour in real time.

* Simulate the digital and analog signals associated with the aircraft’s avionics systems.

* Participate in all phases of software development, including problem analysis, requirements definition, design, implementation, informal testing, troubleshooting, and integration.

* Support the software’s user community.

* Work with several simulation models used for a single aircraft and adapt your approach to different systems and technical requirements.

* Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team of approximately 10 employees, including a subgroup of approximately four employees that works closely with other subgroups.

* Work autonomously while collaborating regularly with software, systems, avionics, and other engineering groups.

Valid driver’s license, or ability to commute to the Mirabel offices  

  

**This is a full-time, Monday-Friday hybrid working arrangement, with an expected presence of two to three days per week at the Mirabel office and occasional work from the Saint-Laurent office. Core working hours are from 9:30AM – 3:30PM.**

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science.

* Up to three years of software development experience.

* Knowledge of C++ and C#.

* Ability to learn aircraft systems, simulation models, and new technical concepts quickly.

* Ability to work autonomously, manage changing technical requirements, and demonstrate flexibility across multiple simulation models.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

* Ability to communicate orally and in writing about technical subjects in English or French.

* Ability to meet the requirements of Canada’s Controlled Goods Program and, in certain cases, applicable International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements.

Eligibility to obtain and maintain Government of Canada Reliability Status and a Level II Secret security clearance.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Rust or Java.

* Knowledge of FPGA development or technologies.

* Knowledge of aeronautics, avionics, or aircraft systems.

* Experience developing real-time simulation software.

Demonstrated interest in aviation.  

  

**Benefits**

We’ve designed flexible policies to promote well-being and growth, based on role-specific eligibility and requirements:

* Hybrid work arrangement combining office-based and remote work.

* Flexible working hours.

* Career development and internal mobility opportunities within CAE.

* Mentoring and access to the CAE Career Track program.

* Collaborative and positive work environment.

* Opportunity to be part of a small professional community within a large organization.

* Work-life balance.

* Comprehensive CAE benefits program, including health insurance, an employee stock purchase plan, a pension plan, and a physical activity program.

**About CAE**
=============

*At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.*

**Position Type**
=================

Regular

**Equal Opportunity & Accommodations**
======================================

*CAE is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, veteran status, age, or other characteristics protected by law. We encourage applicants who may not meet every qualification to apply. Reasonable accommodations are available—contact your recruiter or email* *CAECarrieres-Careers@cae.com* *if needed.*

**Data Privacy**
================

Privacy Statement | CAE

*As part of our process, we may use AI‑supported tools to help review applications, with human decision‑making at every step. CAE thanks all applicants for their interest. However, only those whose background and experience match the requirements of the role will be contacted.*

jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Junior Full-Stack Software Developer**

**About Effortless Admin**  
  
Benefits administration is complicated, and when it goes wrong, real people miss coverage they're counting on. Effortless Admin builds the platform that keeps it running smoothly for employers across Canada. We're a small team that moves fast. The code you write ships to real clients, and you'll see the difference it makes.  
  
**The role**  
**Full-time - On-site in Edmonton, AB**  
  
As a Junior Full-Stack Developer, you'll build features across our platform using React on the front end and C#/.NET on the back end. You'll work side by side with senior developers who will review your code, pair with you, and help you grow quickly.  
  
**Why you'll like working here**  
  
We're a small team, and that's a big part of what makes this role different. You'll work closely with senior developers every day, with real pairing, quick answers when you're stuck, and direct feedback on your code.  
Because we're small and move quickly, good ideas don't sit in a backlog for months. The features you build will ship to real clients, and you'll see the impact of your work early and often.  
  
**How we're working with AI**  
  
We're actively bringing AI into how we work, using it to help us write, review, and test code, and exploring where it can make our platform better for clients.  
We don't have it all figured out, and that's the point. We're learning and experimenting as a team, and we want developers who are curious about it and will help us find where it makes a real difference. You don't need to be an expert, just interested.  
  
**What you'll do**

* Build responsive, easy-to-use interfaces with React and modern JavaScript
* Develop and maintain C#/.NET services that power our core platform
* Design and connect RESTful APIs between the front end and back end
* Work with SQL Server to store and manage application data
* Build reusable components and keep the app fast
* Write clean, well-tested code and take part in code reviews
* Work with our UX designers to turn designs into intuitive experiences
* Experiment with AI tools that help us build better and faster

  

**Who we're looking for**  
You think critically about code, including your own. You ask whether something will be easy to maintain, not just whether it works today, and you can explain your reasoning. You're also open to changing your mind as you learn, because what counts as good code keeps evolving.  
You're adaptable. You're comfortable picking up new tools, switching between front-end and back-end work, and learning as you go. On a small team things change quickly, and that's part of the fun.  
You also care about the people using what you build. You notice when a screen is confusing or a workflow takes one click too many, and you want to fix it. Our users are HR teams and employees dealing with their benefits, and making that experience feel effortless matters to us.

**What you'll bring**  
  
**Must have**

* 1–2 years of hands-on development experience (co-op and internship work counts)
* Solid experience with JavaScript and React
* Working knowledge of C# and .NET
* A good grasp of object-oriented programming
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
* Comfort with SQL and relational databases
* Experience with Git

**Nice to have**

* A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Experience with React libraries like Redux or React Query
* A good understanding of CSS
* Experience on an agile team, using tools like Asana or Jira
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools

**What we offer**

* Competitive pay and a strong benefits package (we are a benefits company, after all)
* Daily mentorship, pairing, and code reviews with senior developers
* A clear path to intermediate and senior roles
* A modern stack and room to try new tools, including AI
* A team that respects work-life balance
* An on-site gym and swimming pool in our building

  

**How to apply**  
  
Send us your resume and a short note about why this role interests you. If you have a GitHub profile or projects you're proud of, include the links. We'd love to see what you've built.

Effortless Admin is committed to building diverse teams and an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

jobs.description:
**Work Location:**

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

**Hours:**

37.5

**Line of Business:**

Technology Solutions

**Pay Details:**

$69,700 - $98,400 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

**Job Description:**

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Risk Technology team within the Finance and Risk Platform group supports non-external-facing credit risk applications used for the Bank’s regulatory capital calculations and reporting to the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI). The team provides System Development Lifecycle (SDLC) services, including business analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Team members collaborate with business and technology partners to deliver reliable, cost-effective solutions in a timely manner.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Risk Technology team is seeking a junior Software Engineer with foundational .NET, Python, and SQL skills. Working with guidance from senior team members, the successful candidate will contribute to understanding requirements and system designs, developing and testing application components, resolving issues, and supporting the delivery of end-to-end solutions. The role offers opportunities to build technical knowledge while contributing to secure, reliable, and maintainable applications.

**The primary accountabilities for this position are:**

* Follow TD technology delivery practices, coding standards, security requirements, and project management disciplines.
* Contribute to application development activities across the SDLC under the guidance of senior team members.
* Review and clarify business requirements, technical designs, and acceptance criteria.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain application components using approved technologies and patterns.
* Write readable, maintainable, and testable code that meets established quality standards.
* Create and execute unit tests, address defects, participate in peer code reviews, and support testing and deployment activities.
* Monitor assigned work, communicate risks or blockers promptly, and complete deliverables within agreed timelines.
* Investigate and resolve routine technical issues, escalating more complex issues when appropriate.
* Apply secure coding practices to help prevent common application vulnerabilities.
* Maintain technical documentation and contribute ideas that improve development, testing, and team efficiency.
Collaborate effectively with team leads, developers, quality engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders.  

  

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Undergraduate degree, college diploma, relevant technical certificate, or equivalent practical experience.
* Up to two years of relevant software development experience, including internships, co-op placements, academic projects, or personal projects.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and business processes.
* Foundational understanding of software development concepts, coding practices, testing, and the SDLC.
* Ability to analyze routine issues, seek guidance when needed, and apply feedback to improve solutions.
* Commitment to delivering high-quality work and continuously developing technical skills.
* Working knowledge of one or more relevant programming languages, development tools, databases, or operating environments.
  + Foundational experience with .NET 8 or later, Python, or a comparable object-oriented programming language
  + Basic knowledge of unit testing frameworks such as NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest
  + Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server
  + Familiarity with web technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS
  + Awareness of REST APIs, web services, and common data formats such as JSON and XML
  + Basic experience with Git version control and collaborative development workflows
  + Exposure to CI/CD concepts or GitHub Actions workflows is an asset
  + Exposure to cloud services, business intelligence tools such as SSRS or SSIS, or UML modelling is an asset
  + Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or comparable AI-assisted development tools is an asset; use must comply with TD AI and information security standards
* Effective time and task management skills, with the ability to organize assigned work and meet agreed timelines.
* Ability to troubleshoot routine software issues using available documentation, tools, and guidance from experienced team members.
* Customer-focused and professional approach, with the ability to work respectfully with business and technology partners.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly, ask questions, take ownership of assigned tasks, and respond constructively to feedback.
* Self-motivated and collaborative team player who can work independently on well-defined tasks and seek support when needed.

**Who We Are:**

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. jobs.title: Jr. Full Stack Developer - Invitation Project
jobs.description:
Jr. Full Stack Developer - Invitation Project

**THE PROJECT**
===============

We are building a subscription-based Evangelism platform to enable ordinary Christians to share their faith.

**THE POSITION**
================

We are seeking a motivated Junior Full-Stack Developer to join our team and help build the core infrastructure of our hybrid evangelism app. You will work closely with senior engineers to design, develop, and maintain the platform's front and back end, focusing on writing clean TypeScript/Node.js code and learning best practices for scalability.

This role is perfect for a candidate who is passionate about technology, eager to learn hybrid mobile development (React Native / Flutter), and curious about relational databases (PostgreSQL). You will collaborate in a supportive environment to help deliver an engaging user experience worldwide.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
====================

* Collaborate with senior developers to build and scale a hybrid mobile application.
* Help manage relational SQL databases and learn data modelling techniques.
* Support the development of backend REST and GraphQL APIs using Node.js, Express, and TypeScript.
* Help implement new frontend features and UI components for mobile and web.
* Ensure smooth authentication using Firebase Auth / Auth0 / Supabase.
* Integrate payment processing with Stripe, PayPal, or Paddle for subscriptions.
* Implement cloud storage solutions (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Cloudflare R2).
* Develop and maintain push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) / OneSignal.
* Optimize the application's performance and security.
* Collaborate with designers, content managers, and other stakeholders.
* Write clean, maintainable code and follow software development best practices.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS REQUIRED**
======================================

* Must be a dedicated Christian and willing to sign a statement of faith
* Willingness to sign a non-disclosure, non-compete agreement.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar experience.
* Basic experience with or a strong desire to learn full-stack development.
* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React, React Native, or Flutter, alongside HTML5/CSS3 and TypeScript.
* Foundational knowledge of backend programming and API concepts.
* Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and ORMs such as Prisma or TypeORM.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
* Knowledge of authentication & security protocols (OAuth, JWT, Firebase Auth, or Auth0).
* Experience with payment gateway integration (Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, etc.).
* Understanding of Git version control and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docker) for efficient deployment.
* Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and receive constructive feedback.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Passion for evangelism and using technology to spread the Gospel.

**BENEFITS**
============

* Flexible working hours and remote work options.
* Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven organization.
* A collaborative and supportive team environment.
* The chance to work on cutting-edge technology for evangelism.
